terra.problem: The verse does not say Ephraim keeps going. The cookie-box comparison also has someone noticing the count dropping, unlike Ephraim, who does not notice his strength being consumed.
“No fighting here” rules out a response the verse does not address. It says Ephraim does not notice his strength being consumed.
“No pleading, no pushback, nothing” states more than the verse says about Ephraim's response.
Calling Moab and Edom nations brings in a Bible fact outside the passage without a reference.
“Keeps flapping back and forth” adds repeated movement. The verse says Ephraim calls out to Egypt, then turns to Assyria.
“They answer with lies” makes the lies a response to the LORD's willingness to redeem them. The verse does not state that connection.
The verse says they do not cry out to the LORD from their hearts when they wail. It does not say their wailing is not from the heart or describe how it reaches Him.
“Loud isn't the same as sincere” treats the people's wailing as insincere. The verse says they do not cry out to the LORD from their hearts when they wail.
The line about loving a good batch uses grain in a food joke rather than simply mentioning it as a Bible fact. It also makes a light aside in the middle of the people's self-harm.
Saying silver and gold sound worth slashing for makes light of the self-harm in the verse.
The verse does not say they used the strength the LORD gave them to plot against Him. It states the two facts without that connection.
“They already speak lies” attributes the people's lies to the leaders and suggests a sequence the passage does not state.
“Real prayer was exactly what was missing” goes beyond the statement that they do not cry out to the LORD from their hearts when they wail upon their beds.
